SHARED-F-2-S36.title: Consent Data Schema and Contract Definition
SHARED-F-2-S36.description: Define Pydantic models and internal data contracts for consent tiers, consent status, and audit metadata. Ensure alignment with two-tier HIPAA workflow and compatibility with lead capture and unknown question flows.

SHARED-F-2-S37.title: Consent API Endpoints and Tool Exposure
SHARED-F-2-S37.description: Expose consent framework through FastAPI endpoints and tool router integration, enabling consent request, update, and retrieval within chat workflows. Ensure allowlist enforcement and validated inputs.

SHARED-F-2-S38.title: Cross-Service Consent Enforcement Integration
SHARED-F-2-S38.description: Integrate consent enforcement across shared domain services including lead capture, unknown question handling, and debug logging to ensure all data flows respect consent tier rules and de-identification requirements.
